retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, desaturated urban portrait featuring heavy distressed textures, cracked overlays, and bold, hand-drawn red accents against a monochromatic background.
triggerTerms: gritty urban portrait with distressed texture
hip-hop album cover style with cracked overlay
monochrome street photography with bold red lettering

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in urban attire stands against a residential brick background, rendered in high-contrast desaturated tones. The entire composition is unified by a heavy, cracked, and weathered texture overlay that mimics aged film or worn paper, punctuated by a large, hand-drawn red graphic element in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast desaturated subject against a textured urban background
Bold red hand-drawn graphic contrasting with monochromatic tones
Heavy distressed overlay unifying foreground and background elements
Angled secondary typography providing a dynamic counterpoint to the central figure
coreInvariants: Heavy cracked and weathered texture overlay across the entire frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central male figure, medium shot from waist up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large red hand-drawn graphic in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves to the bold red graphic, then down to the angled text block and finally to the bottom right advisory badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and textured, with the background house and street providing a busy but desaturated environment.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grays and blacks for the primary imagery.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for highlights and text backgrounds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary hand-drawn graphic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast; the red accent is the only high-saturation element.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold, thick-stroke sans-serif and hand-drawn gestural marks.
letterConstructionRules: Primary graphic: Thick, rounded, hand-drawn strokes with a marker-like quality.
Secondary text: Heavy block sans-serif with uniform stroke width, set inside a rectangular container.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The primary graphic uses exaggerated horizontal bars and rounded terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hand-drawn gestural marks paired with rigid, angled block typography.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed block feel of the secondary text.
Necessary to replicate the gestural, thick-stroke primary graphic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated urban portrait of a man in a black t-shirt and cap standing in front of a brick house. Apply a heavy, cracked, and weathered film texture overlay across the entire image, including a distressed border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, hand-drawn red graphic in the upper right. Below it, add a white rectangular box angled slightly upwards containing bold, black, uppercase sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the texture overlay visible across the entire image?
Is the color palette strictly desaturated with a single red accent?
Is the secondary text contained within an angled white box?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the secondary text box
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red graphic feels integrated into the distressed aesthetic.
Verify the texture does not obscure the subject's face excessively.
Check that the angled text box maintains legibility despite the distress.
Confirm the desaturation is consistent across the background and subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + High Contrast Desaturation + Cracked Film Overlay + Bold Red Hand-Drawn Accent
